name: Consecrated Letter
label: Quest
description: Consecrated Letter: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: In the meantime, you should know one or two other things. You are a symbol to many here in this land--act accordingly. The Holy Light shines within you, and it will be obvious to both your allies and your enemies.

Also, as you gain in wisdom and power, you will need to train to learn new abilities. That's where I come in. When you feel you've gained some experience here in Northshire, come back to me and I will teach you what I feel you are ready to learn. Good luck... Adventurer!

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
